caseNameFull: Bryan v. Moore, Secretary, Florida Department of Corrections

opinions.text: Sup. Ct. Fla. Application for stay of execution of sentence of death, presented to Justice Kennedy, and by him referred to the Court, granted. Motion to consolidate with ease Nos. 99-6668 and 99-6675 denied. Motion for leave to proceed in forma pauperis granted. Certiorari granted.
